title: Ruins of Morah

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Ruins of Morah Campaign Nightfall Region The Desolation Type Cooperative Party size 8 Required hero General Morgahn Duration Short Preceded by Horde of Darkness Followed by Uncharted Territory
The objective of Ruins of Morah is simply to kill Varesh in one last attempt to prevent her from bringing about Nightfall.

You will fight against Varesh twice; during the first part, she fights you as Prophet Varesh, utilizing powerful AoE skills. The second part consists of fighting Commander Varesh as she leads Abaddon's demons to battle.

paragraphs: All party members must have accepted the reward for Horde of Darkness. General Morgahn must be present in the party.

sections.heading: Objective
paragraphs: Kill Varesh.

sections.heading: Walkthrough
paragraphs: Commander Varesh
The dervish form of Prophet Varesh is awaiting the ritual to break Abaddon's prison with three Margonite Clerics in the middle of the crater. Kill the clerics first or pull her away alone.

sections.heading: Recommended: hold the entrance
paragraphs: Killing her is easy—but she will be resurrected after with a variety of Torment creatures—so it is recommended to fight away from the crater and close to the entry point of the mission. Use anti-melee skills (i.e. blind, snares and/or knock downs). Do not stand in either of her Earth or Frost Vortices.

There is a short interval between her first death and her new form as the paragon Commander Varesh. Use the time delay to rush back towards your entry point and flag henchmen/heroes. The new form will not leash as far, so staying next to the door will cause her to run back to the centre of the crater where she spawns. Torment creatures with the skill Call to the Torment (which allows them to duplicate) appear around the crater and start to patrol counter-clockwise. Her new form also has a monster skill called Enemies Must Die! which will focus all of the torment creatures' attacks on one of your allies - just like players targeting priority foes for heroes. Either take out a few demons first to finally strike her, or focus your entire firepower on her to kill her as quickly as possible. The second death of Varesh ends the mission.

Since the spawns of the torment creatures are limited (only 2 spawns of 2 per spawn point and 4 spawn points) it is possible to kill all nearby demons while holding the entrance, making the fight against Varesh's second form much easier.

sections.heading: Alternative: hold the center
paragraphs: Do not use summoning stones, spirits, or minions for this method.

Using caster heroes and henchmen only, move to where Varesh initially spawns in the mission. After killing the Clerics and then the first form of Varesh, instead of flagging your allies atop the hill, keep them with you in the center. If you stay in the center, most of the torment demons should patrol around the area without aggroing your party. Some demons might wander into your Danger Zone but by that time they hopefully shouldn't represent much of a threat.

sections.heading: Skill recommendations
paragraphs: Display your Lightbringer title and bring Lightbringer's Gaze. Melee counter, blind, punishment hexes (such as Spoil Victor and Visions of Regret) for Varesh. Inspired Hex or Revealed Hex to quickly remove Varesh's hexes, since they recharge instantly due to being monster skills. Pain Inverter can hurt Varesh because of her various powerful skills. Party wide and single protective skills like Shield of Absorption and Spirit Bond to counter the spike from enemies when Varesh uses Enemies Must Die!. Ursan Blessing is extremely helpful and easy way to defeat both first and second versions of Varesh.

This article is about a mission. This name is also used for an outpost and a Zaishen mission quest. For the explorable area, see The Ruptured Heart.
Ruins of Morah
Campaign Nightfall
Region The Desolation
Type Cooperative
Party size 8
Required hero General Morgahn

Walkthrough[edit]

Commander Varesh

The dervish form of Prophet Varesh is awaiting the ritual to break Abaddon's prison with three Margonite Clerics in the middle of the crater. Kill the clerics first or pull her away alone.

Recommended: hold the entrance[edit]

Killing her is easy—but she will be resurrected after with a variety of Torment creatures—so it is recommended to fight away from the crater and close to the entry point of the mission. Use anti-melee skills (i.e. blind, snares and/or knock downs). Do not stand in either of her Earth or Frost Vortices.

There is a short interval between her first death and her new form as the paragon Commander Varesh. Use the time delay to rush back towards your entry point and flag henchmen/heroes. The new form will not leash as far, so staying next to the door will cause her to run back to the centre of the crater where she spawns. Torment creatures with the skill Call to the Torment (which allows them to duplicate) appear around the crater and start to patrol counter-clockwise. Her new form also has a monster skill called Enemies Must Die! which will focus all of the torment creatures' attacks on one of your allies - just like players targeting priority foes for heroes. Either take out a few demons first to finally strike her, or focus your entire firepower on her to kill her as quickly as possible. The second death of Varesh ends the mission.

Since the spawns of the torment creatures are limited (only 2 spawns of 2 per spawn point and 4 spawn points) it is possible to kill all nearby demons while holding the entrance, making the fight against Varesh's second form much easier.

Alternative: hold the center[edit]

Do not use summoning stones, spirits, or minions for this method.

Using caster heroes and henchmen only, move to where Varesh initially spawns in the mission. After killing the Clerics and then the first form of Varesh, instead of flagging your allies atop the hill, keep them with you in the center. If you stay in the center, most of the torment demons should patrol around the area without aggroing your party. Some demons might wander into your Danger Zone but by that time they hopefully shouldn't represent much of a threat.

Skill recommendations[edit]

  • Display your Lightbringer title and bring Lightbringer's Gaze.
  • Melee counter, blind, punishment hexes (such as Spoil Victor and Visions of Regret) for Varesh.
  • Inspired Hex or Revealed Hex to quickly remove Varesh's hexes, since they recharge instantly due to being monster skills.
  • Pain Inverter can hurt Varesh because of her various powerful skills.
  • Party wide and single protective skills like Shield of Absorption and Spirit Bond to counter the spike from enemies when Varesh uses Enemies Must Die!.
  • Ursan Blessing is extremely helpful and easy way to defeat both first and second versions of Varesh.

Dialogue[edit]

Opening cinematic[edit]

Morgahn: "The Mouth of Torment. Varesh's mentor, Kahyet, spoke of it."
Morgahn: "It was here that the Five Gods defeated Abaddon."
Morgahn: "Here that the walls of his prison are the weakest."
<Character name>: "Here that Varesh Ossa will finish her ritual."
Morgahn: "She will turn the world into Torment, and unleash Abaddon into that world."
<Character name>: "Are you up for this?"
Morgahn: "Yes. No. I just remember Varesh as she was. She did so much for Kourna. She was a good leader."
<Character name>: "She has been touched by Abaddon."
Morgahn: "We have all been touched by Abaddon. Our entire world. We must stop it now."
<Character name>: "When the time comes, you have to strike."
Morgahn: "I know. But I will strike her down only because I remember what she was."
Morgahn: "I will redeem her memory."
<Character name>: "That will be good enough."

Ending cinematic[edit]

Morgahn: "I am sorry, Varesh. Both for you and for Elona."
<Character name>: "What now, Morgahn? We stopped the ritual. Does it end with Varesh's death?"
Morgahn: "I don't know. Each part of the ritual, at Gandara, at the Temple of Lyssa, and now here, was to weaken the walls of Abaddon's prison."

<Character name>: "Everyone! Out of the area! Now!"
Night has fallen on Elona.
The heroes must confront the dark god Abaddon...
In the Realm of Torment itself.
